title: [GMCP 203.016.01] Contract: First-class extension framework and extension governance
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-016-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: Namespaced MCP extensions can be discovered, negotiated, configured, versioned, isolated and disabled through one typed framework without forking core protocol code. Unknown extensions round-trip safely, required unsupported extensions fail explicitly, official and experimental status is visible, collision and downgrade rules are enforced, and a watch process opens roadmap work for every newly published official extension. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
